title: Notification ABC with Self-Registration
instructions: Finish `notification.py`. Make `NotificationChannel` register each named subclass in its class-level `registry` from `__init_subclass__(cls, channel_name=None, **kwargs)`, and implement `send` and `get_status` on `SMSChannel`, `EmailChannel` and `PushChannel`. The abstract class and any subclass missing an abstract method must not be instantiable.

evidence.label: Built-in channels register as sms, email and push
SMS send prints the documented line
Email and Push print one line naming channel, user and message
get_status returns DELIVERED for every channel
The ABC and incomplete subclasses cannot be instantiated
A new named subclass registers when its class is defined
A subclass without a name is created but not registered
Other class keywords are forwarded to super().__init_subclass__
Unknown class keywords are still rejected
